name: Accountability
overview: Scripture teaches that accountability is a personal and divine responsibility where each individual will be judged according to their deeds and words. The Lord examines the heart and rewards or disciplines accordingly, emphasizing that one’s actions cannot be transferred to another, as seen in Ezekiel 18:20 and Jeremiah 17:10. Believers are called to mutual encouragement and correction, sharpening one another like iron sharpens iron (Proverbs 27:17) and recognizing that partnership strengthens their labor (Ecclesiastes 4:9). Ultimately, accountability includes readiness to obey God’s will, with consequences for neglecting it, as illustrated in Luke 12:47 and the warning that every idle word will be accounted for on the day of judgment (Matthew 12:36).
